identity.title: The weight of memory: nutrition, diabetes, and the brain.

content.abstract: This issue of the Biomedical Journal explores therapeutic approaches to neuroinflammation, antimicrobial resistance, and cancer, as well as developments in laboratory testing and prognostic assessment. Experimental findings show that glibenclamide attenuates palmitic acid-induced hippocampal inflammation and memory impairment in mice. In antimicrobial research, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated elimination of resistance genes restores ertapenem susceptibility in resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, while deep learning offers an approach to interpreting antimicrobial susceptibility tests from images. Oncology articles span molecular characterization, treatment, and prognosis: BK polyomavirus integration and aristolochic acid exposure are associated with distinct molecular features in kidney transplant-associated urothelial carcinomas; bavachinin enhances cisplatin's antitumor activity in oral cancer models; biomarker changes inform prognosis during radium-223 therapy; and external validation supports the MAGIC-D model in advanced biliary tract cancer. Furthermore, research on cartilage homeostasis examines exercise-dependent responses of Prg4-expressing cells. Correspondence addresses combined radiotherapy and systemic treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma and, in a second exchange, stewardship of short-term systemic corticosteroid use.
